title: Vision Prescription Sphere Change Leaderboard
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vision:prescription sphere_delta=*
| stats sum(sphere_delta) as total_value, avg(sphere_delta) as avg_value by optometrist
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks optometrist values by total and average sphere change across vision prescription events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `sphere_delta` values for each vision prescription event and review total and average sphere change by optometrist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total sphere change.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which optometrist shows the biggest sphere change numbers in your vision prescription data.
